problem_type: saved custom authorization override lost during credential validation
symptom: Settings key replacement sent the default Bearer header even when a relay had a saved Authorization override.
direct_cause: validateCandidateCredential merged generated auth headers after saved extraHeaders, so the generated Bearer value won case-insensitively.
class_root: All model-list credential probes must share one header precedence rule: generated auth first, saved custom headers last.
affected_population: custom relays and proxies with Authorization or other header overrides
users replacing relay keys in Model Settings
internal_only_reason: The invariant is owned by Nomi request construction and encrypted catalog state; repository source and the real catalog/API regression decide it.
invariants: saved custom headers are replayed during credential validation
header merge is case-insensitive with saved extras last

door_reduction.why_not: The renderer mutation is the public write entry and validateCandidateCredential is the shared validation boundary; both remain necessary.

generality_proof: The shared buildAuthHeaders path covers Authorization, x-api-key and custom relay headers for settings replacement and model-list probes; existing onboarding and vendor-health callers already use the same precedence.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Owns case-insensitive generated-auth plus saved-extra-header precedence.
Uses the shared builder before accepting a replacement key.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Existing vendor-health tests already assert custom Authorization override.

recurrence.reason: Any local merge-order copy can regress another saved relay header or entry point.

prevention.invariant: All credential model-list requests put saved extra headers after generated auth.
prevention.failure_mode: A valid override is preserved; auth failures remain auth failures.
prevention.strategy: Remove the local merge and reuse the shared builder.

legacy_paths.rationale: The local merge was replaced; no parallel legacy caller remains.

migration: Existing encrypted meta.extraHeaders are read through readCatalog; no migration is needed.
residual_risks: The two UX fixtures still use isolated fake HTTP and need their final full-run receipts.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The shared validation boundary owns this invariant and its focused regression test.
